R335 A-Conform — Heron (frozen spec) → OUR landing page mapping. Two modes: (a) 'explicit' — heron role path (exact or suffix match) → our CSS selector, resolved inside the section container; (b) heuristic fallback — match by structure: same tag + same text-class (tc) + same ordinal position within that (tag,tc) group in document order. Phase 2 agents add data-spec hooks and extend 'explicit'. 'ourSection' holds the REAL container selectors of our React SPA (verified against frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx r335). 'scaleFactor' multiplies fs/lh tolerances per section (Arabic renders slightly different metric heights; default 1.0 until measured). [P2-0 split: one file per our-section key, named with the EXACT key run.mjs uses — run.mjs merges every *.json in this directory. This file: hero band — section.fo-hero (the Hero component, components/landing/hero/Hero.tsx).]
R347 D4 re-key (the defect fix legitimately changed the live contract): the drafting noise chrome is retired with its elements (dashed rulers, ± registration marks, measure graticule, deco [0x] cards, the edge frame + corner plus-marks, the per-div grid and vector-chrome layers) — ONE calm artwork per the owner's directive; docs/redesign/r347/DEFECTS-A.md. Their binding entries are deleted with the elements (never left as no-counterpart failures, never re-bound to ghosts); the retired heron-side paths are carried in the plumbing list with the same written reason.
